components.name: Anchor
components.help: Keeps the object at a fixed offset from a screen edge or corner. Dragging the object edits the offset.

components.name: Fit
components.help: Scales the object so it fits the screen, following resizes. Contain fits inside, cover fills it.

components.name: Button
components.help: Pointer cursor plus hover and press feedback. Handle clicks in code with target.on("pointertap", …).

components.name: Toggle
components.help: Turns the object into an on/off switch: tapping flips it and dims it when off. Listen with target.on("toggle", …).

components.name: Draggable
components.help: Lets the player grab and drag the object with the pointer. Disabled while the editor is paused.

components.name: Tween
components.help: Looping idle animation on top of the object's values. Paused in Edit mode — switch to Play to preview.

components.name: Spin
components.help: Rotates the object continuously. Paused in Edit mode — switch to Play to preview.

components.name: Orbit
components.help: Moves the object in a circle around its position. Paused in Edit mode — switch to Play to preview.

components.name: Shake
components.help: Jitters the object around its position. Paused in Edit mode — switch to Play to preview.

components.name: Appear
components.help: Plays a one-off entrance when the game starts. Shows the final state in Edit mode.

components.name: FollowPointer
components.help: Eases the object toward the pointer every frame. Paused in Edit mode.

components.name: Blur
components.help: Applies a Gaussian blur to the object. Stacks with other filter components.

components.name: ColorAdjust
components.help: Adjusts brightness, saturation and tint with a colour-matrix filter. Stacks with other filters.
